title: Is Google Business Profile enough for AI visibility?

facts.fact: Cheers' Market Baseline reports that business websites supplied 68.1% of pooled citations in local AI results.
facts.quote: Business websites supplied **68.1% of pooled citations**, while Google surfaces supplied **3.3%**

facts.fact: Cheers' Market Baseline reports that Google surfaces supplied 3.3% of pooled citations in local AI results.
The Cheers Market Baseline citation figures come from 49,677 local-intent runs.
facts.quote: 100 metros, four engines, 49,677 runs, 356,019 citations, aggregate only

facts.fact: The Cheers Market Baseline citation figures include 356,019 citations.
facts.quote: 100 metros, four engines, 49,677 runs, 356,019 citations, aggregate only

facts.fact: The Cheers Market Baseline covers 100 metros and four AI engines.
facts.quote: 100 metros, four engines, 49,677 runs, 356,019 citations, aggregate only

facts.fact: The Cheers Market Baseline citation statistics were corrected on September 23, 2026.
Google Search Central's guidance on local businesses and AI search was updated July 10, 2026.
Google's documentation states that businesses should not just recycle what others have said or what a generative AI model could easily produce.
facts.quote: Don't just recycle what others on the internet have already said, or could easily be produced by a generative AI model.

facts.fact: Google says AI Overviews and AI Mode rely on the same Search fundamentals, including indexed pages, crawlable content, internal links, visible text, page experience, and structured data that matches the page.
facts.quote: Google also says AI Overviews and AI Mode rely on the same Search fundamentals: indexed pages, crawlable content, internal links, visible text, page experience, and structured data that matches the page.

facts.fact: The article was published May 30, 2026 and updated September 2, 2026.
